name: KpMath Sans (font, in SwiftMath)
note: SwiftMath 1.7.3 ships KpMath-Sans.otf in mathFonts.bundle, copied into the app as a resource. The copyright is the font's own name-table notice; the licence is the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (mathFonts.bundle/OFL.txt's licence text). SwiftMath's collector-walked mathFonts.bundle/LICENSE is MathChat's MIT notice for the plists, not the fonts.
